grammarFocus: 一般现在时；I / you / we / they 的实义动词；时间表达与频率词入门。
title: Daily Routines and Habits: A Morning Chat
instructions: 听录音，完成8个问题。录音播放两遍。注意时间表达和频率词。所有内容为模拟教学材料，非官方雅思考试。
transcript: A: Hi, I'm Li. I start work at eight. What about you? B: I start at nine. I usually walk to work. A: Do you walk every day? B: No, not every day. I sometimes take the bus. A: I always walk. It's good exercise. B: You're right. I often walk, too. A: What time do you get up? B: I get up at seven. A: Seven? I get up at six thirty. B: That's early! Do you have breakfast? A: Yes, I always have breakfast. B: I usually have breakfast at home. A: We sometimes meet for coffee after work. B: Good idea. Let's meet on Friday.

questions.explanation: Li 说“I start work at eight.”，所以是八点。

grammar.title: 一般现在时：I / you / we / they + 实义动词
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常发生的动作或习惯。主语是 I、you、we、they 时，动词用原形，不加 -s。例如：I walk. You walk. We walk. They walk. 否定用 don't + 动词原形，疑问用 Do + 主语 + 动词原形。

options: I walk to school every day.
I walks to school every day.
I walking to school every day.
I am walk to school every day.
answers: I walk to school every day.
questions.explanation: 主语 I 后动词用原形 walk，所以第一句正确。
questions.evidence: I walk to school every day.

options: They usually is take the bus.
questions.explanation: 主语 They 后动词用原形 take，所以第一句正确。

options: We don't have breakfast at home.
We doesn't have breakfast at home.
We not have breakfast at home.
We no have breakfast at home.
answers: We don't have breakfast at home.
questions.explanation: 主语 We 的否定用 don't + 动词原形，所以第一句正确。
questions.evidence: We don't have breakfast at home.

questions.explanation: 主语 you 的疑问用 Do + 主语 + 动词原形，所以第一句正确。
